raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00) with identical rows, so 654 rows arrived instead of about 330. silver_transactions has no dedup, so 305 POSTED txn_ids are duplicated and the gold counts and totals are inflated. Every txn_id has a contiguous range (distinct = max - min + 1), and the 327 extra rows account for the whole excess in batch 13.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1"}}
